summary: Research Alliance Corp III files Form 8-K reporting the completion of its initial public offering (IPO) on May 21, 2026. The SPAC issued 7,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at $10.00/share, generating $75M in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 275,000 private placement shares at $10.00/share for $2.75M. Net proceeds of $75M were deposited into a trust account with Continental Stock Transfer Trust Company. The filing includes an audited balance sheet. As a blank-check company, the focus now shifts to identifying a target for a business combination within the required timeframe. Watch for subsequent acquisitions or liquidation risk if no deal is announced.
